The Boy Who Never Forgot: 记性超群的小男孩帮邻居找回钥匙。
Ollie is six years old. He has a great memory. He remembers every street and every shop in the town.
One day, old Mrs Wood loses her keys. She looks in her bag, her pockets and her car, but she cannot find them.

Ollie thinks for a minute. In the morning, he sees Mrs Wood at the fruit shop. She buys apples and puts her keys on the table there! They go to the fruit shop together. The keys are still on the table. Mrs Wood thanks Ollie again and again.

# title: Where does Ollie see Mrs Wood in the morning?
The Boy Who Never Forgot: At the bus stop.|At the fruit shop.|In the park.|At school.
In Mrs Wood's car.|On the table at the fruit shop.|In Ollie's pocket.|At home.
